title: Unicorn Horn
summary: Unobtainable ingredient for the unavailable Angelic Reprieve recipe.

fields.Extraction: Combine 3 Unicorn Horns to make Essence of Unicorn Horn. Add any Salt to make Potion of Angelic Reprieve.
fields.Availability: Unobtainable in normal play, so the potion cannot be crafted.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
